# Windows

<!-- Generated by `bogey docs` from packages/config/src/windows.ts. Do not edit manually. -->

A window is a stretch of time in which something is allowed: scheduled with an open and a close time, or forced open or
closed. The database enforces them. Organizers set them under Manage → Agenda. Plugins add their own as `<plugin>.<window>`.

| Key | Name | While it is open |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `registration` | Registration | People can register for the event |
| `checkin` | Check-in | Staff check people in, and people check themselves in with the venue code |
| `teams` | Team changes | Participants create, join and leave teams |
| `instructions` | Instructions | Pages and sections held back until then become visible |
| `sessions` | Session sign-ups | Participants sign up for the agenda's sessions |
| `submissions` | Submissions | Teams edit and submit their projects (each form can have its own, `submit-<form>`) |
| `judging` | Judging | Judges score, and rounds can advance |
| `voting` | Popular vote | Eligible people vote for projects |
| `results` | Results | Published results and awards are visible to participants |
| `gallery` | Project gallery | Shared projects are visible on the public gallery |
